annotations.rationale: The customer blames the MFA rollout from the previous Friday (ev01) and the first move (ev02) follows that guess by asking for users to be excluded from the policy, which changes nothing (ev03). A log lookup, available at once and without customer effort, finds no rows and no MFA/CA results (ev06); the engineer owns the mistake. The page wording and the site pattern (ev05) point at name resolution, and the per-resolver answers (ev08) show the new filtering resolver giving nothing. The fix and its check follow (ev09 to ev11). The quoted line in ev04 repeats the customer's earlier result and is not a new statement.
